item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a fixed bedtime and a wind-down routine built in, which is the hard part. Sleep is won in the hour before bed, not in bed. Dim the lights, put the phone out of reach, and let the body practice the relaxation you've already scheduled. Consistency beats effort here. Tonight, start your wind-down on time and keep your lights low from that moment on.
